mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for installing a water feature in Pasadena?

acceptedAnswer.text: For properties in Pasadena, the requirement for permits when installing a water feature depends on its size, depth, and specific characteristics. Small, pre-fabricated fountains or ponds may not always require a permit, but larger, custom-built features, especially those with significant excavation, plumbing, or electrical work, almost certainly will. It's crucial to consult with the Pasadena Department of Public Works or a qualified contractor to understand local zoning ordinances and building codes before beginning any construction to ensure compliance and avoid potential issues.
